looks.name: Lighthouse oilskin
looks.text: A yellow oilskin to the knees and a sou'wester, as a lighthouse keeper wears them out in any weather.

looks.name: Winter parka
looks.text: A long parka with its hood lined in fur, and red mittens, for the coldest nights out there.

looks.name: NAPO dress uniform
looks.text: NAPO's navy dress uniform, with its yellow trim, white gloves and a peaked cap.

looks.name: Festival sweater
looks.text: Knitted by hand in cranberry and cream, with earmuffs to match: a sweater for a festival night.

looks.name: Argyle
looks.text: Diamonds down the front and on the sleeves, in two shades of the cloth.

looks.name: Aurora bands
looks.text: A green band and a violet one round the body, the colors of the sky every third night.

looks.name: Lightning
looks.text: A yellow bolt down the front, for whoever walks out into the storms.

looks.name: Heart
looks.text: A red heart, for whoever helps keep napoland going.

looks.name: The Tower
looks.text: The NAPO Tower, its red light blinking over the South Road.

looks.name: Snowflake
looks.text: A snowflake, for the coldest nights out there.
